name: check-characteristics-nearmatch-fixture
_why: Planted for @SCN-CHR-001's @integration arm — NOT A NEAR-MATCH COURTESY. `complexty` is one letter from a roster word, and the mint is the act being surfaced, so it is reported as the manifest wrote it and never resolved to `complexity`. The handle is `lint:cpx` on purpose: a handle carrying the roster word as a substring would make the assertion that the roster word is absent from the output unwritable.
